page_title: HEI 0-2 HAM | Heidenheim v Hamburger SV 07/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+4' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Heidenheim.
90+2' The current number of shots on goal is 4:5.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' The corner from Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) is cleared away by the defence.
88' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) gets booked for the first time in this match.
88' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hamburger SV.

85' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
84' The goal by Heidenheim won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
83' Wait! Referee Daniel Siebert has indicated he is going to review the Heidenheim goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

82' GOAL! Superb work from Budu Zivzivadze, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim), who beats Daniel Heuer Fernandes with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
80' Merlin Polzin prepares a substitution. Fabio Vieira is replaced by Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger).

78' 0 - 2 Goal! Fabio Vieira displays great vision and sends a pass to Rayan Philippe (Hamburger), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the left post. The score is 0:2.
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Benedikt Gimber walks off the pitch to be replaced by Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).

76' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
76' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
76' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
74' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but he sent it well over the bar.
73' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) will deliver the corner kick.
73' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 5:7.

67' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Daniel Heuer Fernandes dived superbly to block a header by Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed towards the top left corner, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes pulled off a remarkable save!
66' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

29' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) tries to find Arijon Ibrahimovic, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
28' Daniel Siebert couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) and blew his whistle.
27' The ratio of the ball possession is 41:59.
25' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

25' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Diant Ramaj was alert and the score remains the same.
24' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is first to the rebound and attempts to beat the keeper from long range. It's a decent effort, but flies just wide of the left post.

23' Hennes Behrens (Heidenheim) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
20' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) was quite harsh and Daniel Siebert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
7' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
